region.name: Kyiv Air-Matched Box (0.5 deg, cross-layer check)
region.spatial_resolution_note: OMI OMNO2d v004 (0.25 deg), VIIRS S-NPP SV-C2 (375 m nominal), and NASA POWER MERRA-2/CERES (0.5 deg x 0.625 deg / 1.0 deg sampled over a 3x3 cos(lat) grid). Box means describe area averages, not street-level or point exposure.

kyiv_daily_wind_cloud_sensitivity.purpose: Tests whether 2022 Kyiv NO2 decrease holds under stagnant low-wind (<3 m/s) and clear-sky filtering.

strata.rule: All valid Mar–Aug OMI retrieval days

kyiv_intervention_and_weather_controls.inference_caveat: Exploratory quasi-experimental diagnostics on n=1 post-invasion season (6 months). Controls for observed MERRA-2/CERES meteorology but does NOT replace a multi-year before/after test or clean NO2 control city.

empirical_breakpoint_check.interpretation: Single linear slope preferred over piecewise hinge (Davies p=0.2718, dBIC=-4.6).

regional_fire_water_earth_contrast.interpretation: Fire-weather mismatch: Western and Central interior benchmarks experienced stronger 2022 evaporative drying (higher VPD, lower surface soil moisture) yet saw vegetation-type fire detections fall markedly, whereas the Donbas-Kharkiv frontline corridor had near-baseline VPD/soil moisture while type0 detections rose +72.4% and type2 static industrial anomalies collapsed -83.3%.

limitations: Only one post-invasion spring-summer war season (Mar-Aug 2022) is present; formal before/after seasonal inference remains not_assessed.
April 2022 OMI NO2 contains only 8/30 valid days (26.67% coverage); sensitivity checks excluding 2022-04 are reported explicitly.
FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP has known orbit gaps in 2022-07-27..2022-08-10 and 2022-03-05; rates normalize by observed satellite days.
NASA POWER MERRA-2 resolution (0.5 deg x 0.625 deg) captures synoptic/regional hydrology and meteorology rather than urban street microclimates.
External Krakow/Prague boxes supply meteorological context only (NO2 comparability requires matched OMI/TROPOMI retrievals).
